notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Change bonuses requires stopping this slot first. Clicking while it runs only shows a message. Confirming makes one change, even if the targets already match.
translation: Skift bonusser kræver, at pladsen stoppes først. Klik, mens den kører, viser kun en besked. Bekræft laver ét skift, også selvom målene allerede passer.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start/Stop ignores double-clicks for 0.5 s. Start waits for the previous result; a blocking popup names the bonus and reason.
translation: Start/Stop ignorerer dobbeltklik i 0,5 s. Start venter på det forrige resultat; en blokerende pop op nævner bonus og årsag.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: 5. One speed for all three slots
translation: 5. Én hastighed for alle tre pladser
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: The slider sets the gap between the requests of all active slots: 0.05-1 s.
translation: Skyderen indstiller pausen mellem forespørgslerne fra alle aktive pladser: 0,05-1 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: The step is 0.05 s. The default is 0.05 s; the chosen speed is remembered.
translation: Trinnet er 0,05 s. Standard er 0,05 s; den valgte hastighed huskes.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: With 3 items at 0.1 s each item changes about every 0.3 s.
translation: Med 3 genstande på 0,1 s skifter hver genstand cirka hvert 0,3 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: When one finishes, the others speed up. Server delays can slow them down.
translation: Når én er færdig, bliver de andre hurtigere. Serverforsinkelser kan bremse dem.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Close, X or Esc hide BS without stopping rerolling. With BS open, hits produce neither PM nor minimap notifications.
translation: Luk, X eller Esc skjuler BS uden at stoppe omrulningen. Med BS åben giver træffere hverken PB eller minikortnotifikation.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: PM mode hides the status panel by the minimap. Popup and Popup + PM show the counters and speed.
translation: PB-tilstand skjuler statuspanelet ved minikortet. Pop op og Pop op + PB viser tællere og hastighed.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start / Stop in the minimap status panel controls all BS slots. Open BS window shows the full window. The notification type is shared by accounts using this client folder.
translation: Start / Stop i minikortets statuspanel styrer alle BS-pladser. Åbn BS-vinduet viser hele vinduet. Notifikationstypen deles af konti, der bruger denne klientmappe.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Choose Popup, PM or Popup + PM next to Presets. Hit notifications work only in the background. PM briefly pauses rerolls until its quest ends.
translation: Vælg Pop op, PB eller Pop op + PB ved siden af Forudindstillinger. Træffernotifikationer virker kun i baggrunden. PB sætter omrulningen kort på pause, til dens quest slutter.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS waits for a change to be confirmed before it sends the next request.
translation: BS venter på bekræftelse af et skift, før den sender næste forespørgsel.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS waits up to 5 s for confirmation, then retries after about 1 s. Three consecutive unconfirmed attempts stop the slot.
translation: BS venter op op til 5 s på bekræftelse og prøver igen efter cirka 1 s. Tre ubekræftede forsøg i træk stopper pladsen.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Trade, storage, shops and NPC dialogs pause BS until the blocking window closes. After death, BS waits for revival.
translation: Handel, lager, butikker og NPC-dialoger sætter BS på pause, til det blokerende vindue lukker. Efter døden venter BS på genoplivning.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A manual stop is never resumed by itself.
translation: Et manuelt stop genoptages aldrig af sig selv.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: 8. Teleports, channels and where the item is
translation: 8. Teleporter, kanaler og hvor genstanden er
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: You can change the channel while rerolling. After a channel change or a teleport BS resumes after 5 s.
translation: Du kan skifte kanal under omrulning. Efter kanalskift eller teleport fortsætter BS efter 5 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: It resumes only if the item is still in the remembered inventory slot.
translation: Den fortsætter kun, hvis genstanden stadig ligger på den huskede inventarplads.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Picking up the item pauses BS. Returning it to the same cell resumes work without resetting the counter.
translation: At tage genstanden op sætter BS på pause. Lægges den tilbage i samme felt, fortsætter arbejdet uden nulstilling af tælleren.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Moving stops BS. Right-click the same item in EQ to assign it again. You can also drag it onto its BS slot or return it to its previous EQ slot; then click Start.
translation: Flytning stopper BS. Højreklik på samme genstand i EQ for at tildele den igen. Du kan også trække den over på dens BS-plads eller sætte den tilbage på dens tidligere EQ-plads; klik så på Start.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: 9. Buying reroll scrolls in the ItemShop
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS buys 200 scrolls for DC when fewer than 200 remain. It buys while rerolling or processing a manual change.
translation: BS køber 200 skriftruller for DC, når der er færre end 200 tilbage. Den køber under omrulning eller et manuelt skift.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Switching it on asks for your consent and shows the price. It applies to this character only.
translation: At slå det til beder om dit samtykke og viser prisen. Det gælder kun denne figur.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A purchase needs free inventory space. If another window blocks it, BS retries every 5 s.
translation: Et køb kræver ledig plads i inventaret. Blokerer et andet vindue det, prøver BS igen hvert 5. s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Missing Dragon Coins, or a purchase that left no scrolls in the inventory, stops BS.
translation: Manglende Dragemønter eller et køb, der ikke efterlod skriftruller i inventaret, stopper BS.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Save preset stores both sets, the chosen bonuses and their values under a name.
translation: Gem forudindstilling gemmer begge sæt, de valgte bonusser og deres værdier under et navn.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Each category has its own presets: PvP can be saved separately for weapons and shoes.
translation: Hver kategori har sine egne forudindstillinger: PvP kan gemmes separat for våben og sko.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Bonus catalog: choose a category card with an icon to view its bonuses and possible values.
translation: Bonuskatalog: vælg et kategorikort med ikon for at se dets bonusser og mulige værdier.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Compatible replacements keep targets. Another matching item needs Start. Restarting clears slots; named presets remain.
translation: Kompatible erstatninger beholder målene. En anden passende genstand kræver Start. Genstart rydder pladserne; navngivne forudindstillinger bliver.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Presets can load before bonuses exist; Start checks targets. In the selection window, right-click adds to a free slot; dragging replaces a taken one.
translation: Forudindstillinger kan indlæses, før bonusser findes; Start tjekker målene. I valgvinduet tilføjer højreklik til en ledig plads; træk erstatter en optaget.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Replacing selected bonuses, overwriting and deleting presets require confirmation. Presets are shared and synchronized between clients using the same folder.
translation: Udskiftning af valgte bonusser, overskrivning og sletning af forudindstillinger kræver bekræftelse. Forudindstillinger deles og synkroniseres mellem klienter i samme mappe.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A chosen bonus gets its maximum value; you can type your own.
translation: En valgt bonus får sin maksimale værdi; du kan skrive din egen.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Ordinary bonuses and values are green, maximum values gold, negative ones red.
translation: Almindelige bonusser og værdier er grønne, maksimale værdier guld, negative røde.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Green in BS and inventory means the targets were reached. Red and yellow cover the full item size (1-3 cells).
translation: Grøn i BS og inventaret betyder, at målene er nået. Rød og gul dækker hele genstandens størrelse (1-3 felter).
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A selected tab has white text and border; inactive sets keep a red background. Counters total usage and purchases.
translation: En valgt fane har hvid tekst og ramme; inaktive sæt beholder en rød baggrund. Tællere summerer forbrug og køb.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A right click on the item icon in BS works like Clear: the slot and its targets go.
translation: Et højreklik på genstandsikonet i BS virker som Ryd: pladsen og dens mål forsvinder.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Clear all clears every slot, the used-scroll counter and notifications. Clear dismisses the notification for that slot.
translation: Ryd alle rydder alle pladser, tælleren for brugte skriftruller og notifikationer. Ryd fjerner notifikationen for pladsen.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Presets and inventory items remain after clearing. Full slots also show a popup; identical matches need dragging.
translation: Forudindstillinger og genstande i inventaret bliver efter rydning. Fulde pladser viser også en pop op; identiske match skal trækkes.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Changing targets or restarting a slot dismisses its previous notification.
translation: At ændre mål eller genstarte en plads fjerner dens tidligere notifikation.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Red marks the selected item. Yellow with its BS slot number marks the original cell. Closing Info resets the page.
translation: Rød markerer den valgte genstand. Gul med BS-pladsnummer markerer det oprindelige felt. Luk Info nulstiller siden.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
